name: Oxylabs Web API
description: Web search and page fetching through the Oxylabs Web API.

webSearch.apiKey.label: Oxylabs Web API key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Oxylabs Web API key for web search (fallback: OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY env var).

webSearch.location.label: Default search location
webSearch.location.help: Two-letter country code that search results are localised to when a call does not give one, e.g. US or DE.

webFetch.apiKey.label: Oxylabs Web API key (fetch)
webFetch.apiKey.help: Optional. Falls back to the web search key, then the OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY env var.

webFetch.renderJs.label: Render JavaScript
webFetch.renderJs.help: Render pages in a browser before extracting them. Slower; turn on for JavaScript-heavy sites.
